meta.name: novel-game-analyze
meta.description: Deconstruct a novel for game adaptation. Compress a raw novel, deconstruction library, or writing project into a SOURCE_BIBLE with cited textual evidence, extracting world rules, player verbs, spaces, character will, systems, and visual anchors — without inventing a genre yet. Use for gameable book analysis, analyze a novel for game adaptation, extract game systems from a book. 游戏化拆书。把原始小说、拆文库或写作工程压缩成有必要原文证据的 SOURCE_BIBLE，提取世界规则、玩家动词、空间、角色意志、系统和视觉锚点，不提前发明游戏类型。用于游戏化拆书、分析小说的游戏改编基础等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解小说，产出带原文证据的游戏改编设定集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把小说改编成游戏，需要先理清哪些内容能变成玩法规则
copy.tagline_en: Break down a novel into a game-ready source bible with cited evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to adapt a novel into a game and need to identify playable elements first

howto.what: 装上后，用户把小说的全文或已有拆解资料交给 Claude，它会把内容压缩成一份带原文证据的 SOURCE_BIBLE，提取世界规则、玩家动词、空间、角色意志、系统和视觉锚点，但不提前定游戏类型。
howto.when: 用户拿小说或拆文库来要求做游戏化拆解、分析游戏化改编基础，或要求提取书里的可游戏系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我拆解这本小说，做成游戏改编用的 SOURCE_BIBLE。
say.note: 会先识别边界并逐单元提取

say.text: 只看第三章的改编基础，别提前定游戏类型。
say.note: 会按指定段落补逐事实表

say.text: 把已有拆文库压缩成带证据的改编边界表。
say.note: 优先复用拆文而非重读全文

howto.what_en: Turns a novel or existing deconstruction into a SOURCE_BIBLE with cited text evidence, extracting world rules, player verbs, spaces, character will, systems, and visual anchors without choosing a genre yet.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks to game-analyze a novel, deconstruct it for adaptation, or extract gameable systems from a book.

say_en.text: Break down this novel into a game-adaptation SOURCE_BIBLE.
say_en.note: It maps boundaries and extracts unit by unit.

say_en.text: Analyze only Chapter 3 for adaptation basics, no genre yet.
say_en.note: It appends a fact-by-fact table for that part.

say_en.text: Compress the existing deconstruction into an adaptation-boundary table.
say_en.note: It reuses existing notes instead of re-reading all.
